annotation.summary: Rebuilt eight circular-area callpoint harnesses over the unique shared CircularAreaBackingResource. Init failure is null/emp; empty Read is ERROR=1 and preserves a full caller buffer; successful Read and non-force Write are EOK=0; Write sets status 1 and Read sets status 0. A separate force audit exposes the raw force result and re-establishes a canonical full FIFO only for a fresh four-byte ring written with exactly four bytes before Release.

spec_definition_review.canonical_resource: Directly re-exports the shared common library; no local duplicate of CircularAreaBackingResource or CircularAreaLogicalState.
spec_definition_review.public_buffer_model: Backing ownership remains UCharArray.mixed_full through the shared resource; no backing-full conversion.
spec_definition_review.read_buffer_model: UCharArray.full with an explicit before-list, matching the proved Read contract.
spec_definition_review.force_model: The extensional physical effect and raw force resource are explicitly separate from the canonical FIFO state.

callpoint_coverage.init_metadata_release: Init success feeds all metadata queries and Release; failure returns 0/emp.
callpoint_coverage.init_empty_read_release: Empty Read returns ERROR=1 and preserves state/full output, then Release.
callpoint_coverage.init_first_write_release: One-byte non-force Write returns EOK=0 and status=1, then Release.
callpoint_coverage.write_read_release: Write then live Read returns the byte, empties the FIFO, and sets status=0.
callpoint_coverage.repeated_write_release: Two non-force Writes append in FIFO order over one mixed backing resource.
callpoint_coverage.read_then_write_release: Write, Read-to-empty, and a second Write compose canonically.
callpoint_coverage.reset_release: Reset preserves the mixed physical list while emptying logical FIFO, then queries and Release are legal.
callpoint_coverage.force_full_release: A fresh capacity-4 ring and exactly four valid bytes expose the raw force effect/resource; an explicit entailment establishes canonical full state before Release.

canonical_symexec_evidence.manual_refresh_note: The existing manual was preserved; controller annotation-check-round owns the authoritative fresh skeleton and diagnostics split.

checked_scope: raw force result and strong-subset canonicalization
annotation_checking_evidence.spec_definition_status: passed: shared canonical definitions are reused directly; result and force-update relations are extensional mathematical properties, not control-flow mirrors
annotation_checking_evidence.function_spec_status: passed: every branch has the exact real return code and correct ownership/state transition
annotation_checking_evidence.annotation_scratch_lib_changes: updated result relations and added four-byte/raw-force relations without duplicating the canonical state
annotation_checking_evidence.resource_model: passed: canonical backing remains mixed_full; Read buffers are full; no undef-to-full or backing-full conversion
annotation_checking_evidence.force_composability: passed: general force post remains raw; only fresh capacity 4 plus exactly four valid bytes is manually entailed to canonical full state before Release

iterations.finding: Old declarations reversed Read/Write results, used undef output, and could not derive force capacity 4.
iterations.repair: Rebuilt contracts and added an explicit post-Init capacity-four assertion.
Added the pointer bridge to both force assertions.

self_repair_budget.budget_disposition: All semantic/tool gates passed and no reworkable failure remained before the maximum repair window.

read_categories: current proved real-function contracts under OUTPUT
qcp-mcp and fixed Coq tooling interfaces

timing_summary.timing_gap_reason: Rule reading, contract inspection, editing, QCP feedback analysis, semantic review, and report assembly were not separately instrumented.
